# Assay machines against Algocell's shaders, pair by pair (generated by `assays_any_isa.py pairs`; do not edit)

Each vendored assay machine (`machines/worlds_assays.json`, provenance in `machines/PROVENANCE_assays.md`) runs the same pairs as the Algocell shaders it replaces, through `algocell_exp.executor.AlgocellShader`: the traced executor (`z80_test_trace[_lethal]_L<L>.wgsl`, derived from `z80_test[_lethal]_L<L>.wgsl` by `gen_trace_shader`, identical execution plus the fetch map) for every group, and the op-traced executor (`optrace`, plus the start map) for the unsuppressed groups. (The plain executor's memory equals the traced one's: `tests/test_assays_any_isa.py`.) Per pair: final memory (both tapes), the writes into A and into B, the fetch map, and the start map where the op-traced executor ran; the op-traced run's memory, writes and fetch-map mismatches are added to the same columns. Archived pairs: lattice neighbours drawn uniformly over the worlds of each archived condition with a final soup (up to 10000 per condition, `zsoup_check.neighbour_pairs`), each run under its condition's own step budget and suppression set. `arch-plain`: no archived soup has this machine's rule, so the plain soups of its length run under the lethal rule. Random: 10000 uniform pairs, unsuppressed and under three random suppression sets of two selectable families. `changed`: pairs whose memory the encounter changed; `entered`: pairs in which a partner position was fetched (shader's map).
